title: Run tree and Overview text: realistic fix-round goldens, engine detail wrap, parked count
lead: *Proposed.* A fix-round golden with real times, vendor, model, effort and a compact token count in mono, colour and ASCII; an engine row's detail that wraps between its cells without leaving one cell alone on the last line; and a Roadmap heading that names parked items.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S230 (S130 items 3, 4 and 5) and S232 (S67 item 4) at f48a6154. The fix-round goldens have no times, vendor or usage and exist only as `runtree-fix-round-{80x24,100x30}-mono-true.txt` (`internal/tui/runtree_test.go:787-808`); the stopped engine detail leaves `2d ago` alone on a line at 100x30 (`testdata/golden/engine-stopped-100x30.txt:26-27`); the Roadmap heading counts a parked item as other (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:331-343`, `testdata/golden/roadmap-parked-100x30-mono.txt:8`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): adj 437 (Q2), an engine row's detail wraps between cells with no lone last cell; adj 442 (Q7), the Roadmap heading reads `N open, M parked, K other`. adj 436 (Q1, keep five Overview lines) retires S130 item 2.

Re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S230, S130 item 3, still present. `TestRunTreeFixRoundGoldens` builds steps with no `BeganAt`, `UpdatedAt`, vendor, model or roles (`internal/tui/runtree_test.go:787-790`), so the goldens show `+ implementer  done  #1` and `| implementer  start  #2 x2` with the detail right after the padded phase, and no usage (`testdata/golden/runtree-fix-round-80x24-mono-true.txt:12-17`). `rg -n '[0-9]k' testdata/golden/runtree-fix-round-*` finds no compact count. Real steps carry an elapsed time, vendor, model and effort before the ordinal and a usage text after it (`internal/tui/runtree.go:321-381`).
- S230, S130 item 5, still present. Only `-mono-true` fix-round goldens exist (`ls testdata/golden | rg fix-round`); other run-tree goldens have colour and `-ascii` variants (`testdata/golden/pane-tail-ascii.txt`, `live-detail-100x30-ascii.txt`).
- S230, S130 item 4, still present; the owner chose wrapping between cells (adj 437). An engine row's detail is `r.ID + "  " + item + "  " + rest` (`internal/tui/overview.go:442`) and wraps by words (`overview.go:1290-1325`) because only waiting and live rows use cells (`:1292-1296`). At 100x30 (detail width 70) the stopped row wraps to `ork-20261019-164000-abcd  S22  stopped  owner action  2 of 6 steps` and `2d ago` (`testdata/golden/engine-stopped-100x30.txt:26-27`).
- S232, S67 item 4, still present; the owner chose `N open, M parked, K other` (adj 442). The heading counts `status == "open"` and calls the rest `other` (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:331-343`), so a Roadmap with a parked item reads `0 ready of 3, 2 open, 1 other` (`testdata/golden/roadmap-parked-100x30-mono.txt:8`) while the row says `parked` (`roadmap.go:390-391`). `docs/dashboard.md:1919-1920` documents `N open, M other`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRunTreeFixRoundRealGoldens` (`internal/tui/runtree_test.go`): an engine run (JSON in the style of `treeEngine`, `:113`) with roles implementer round 1 (claude, sonnet, high, 2m, 23800 tokens), reviewer round 1 (codex, gpt-6.2-sol, medium, 1m, 9100 tokens), gate round 1 failed, implementer round 2 running; the ledger steps of `TestRunTreeFixRoundGoldens` with `begun_at` and `updated_at` set. Goldens `runtree-fix-round-real-80x24-mono-true.txt`, `runtree-fix-round-real-100x30-mono-true.txt`, `runtree-fix-round-real-100x30-mono-false.txt` and `runtree-fix-round-real-100x30-ascii.txt`. The test also asserts that the plain view contains `23.8k` on the line that holds `#1`. Red first: the goldens do not exist (`checkGolden` fails without `-update`).
- `TestEngineDetailWrapsBetweenCells` (`internal/tui/engine_runs_test.go`): the stopped engine row of `engine-stopped-100x30` at detail width 70 gives exactly `ork-20261019-164000-abcd  S22  stopped  owner action` and `2 of 6 steps  2d ago`; at width 58 (80x24) the same two lines. Red first: `2d ago` is alone on the second line at width 70.
- `TestPackCellsLeavesNoLoneLastCell`: the cells packer used for engine detail, given `a`, `b`, `c` of widths that fit two per line except the last, moves the second-to-last cell down so the last line has two cells when they fit together; a last cell too wide to join stays alone. Red first: the helper does not exist.
- `TestRoadmapHeaderCountsParked` (`internal/tui/roadmap_test.go`): from `roadmapHarness`, set S04 to `parked`: the body contains `Roadmap  1 ready of 4, 2 open, 1 parked, 1 other`; also set S03 to `open`: `Roadmap  2 ready of 4, 3 open, 1 parked`. `TestRoadmapHeaderCarriesCounts` keeps `3 open, 1 other` and `all open`. Red first: `1 other` counts the parked item.
- Goldens that change: `engine-stopped-100x30.txt` (lines 26-27), `roadmap-parked-100x30-mono.txt` and `-color.txt` (line 8: `0 ready of 3, 2 open, 1 parked`), and any other engine golden whose detail wraps. Rewrite them with `go test ./internal/tui -update` and review the diff: only those lines may change.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and see them red.
2. `overview.go`: give an engine row `detailCells` (its run id, item and rest parts), and pack them with a variant of `packCells` that leaves no single cell alone on the last line when the cell before it fits there with it. Use the variant for engine rows only; waiting and live rows keep `packCells`.
3. `roadmap.go`: count `parked` apart; the summary is `N open`, then `M parked` when M > 0, then `K other` when K > 0, joined with `, `; `all open` stays.
4. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update`, review every changed golden, then run the tests without `-update`.
5. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md:1919-1920` gives the new heading form; `docs/dashboard.md` near the engine row detail says it wraps between cells with no lone last cell. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.
6. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- A fix-round golden shows elapsed times, vendor, model, effort, '#N' and '23.8k' together, in mono, colour and ASCII.
- At 100x30 a stopped engine row's detail reads 'ork-20261019-164000-abcd  S22  stopped  owner action' then '2 of 6 steps  2d ago'.
- A Roadmap with a parked item reads 'N open, M parked' in its heading.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/tui -run 'FixRoundReal|EngineDetail|PackCells|RoadmapHeader' -v` lists the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `ls testdata/golden | rg 'runtree-fix-round-real'` lists four files.
- `rg -n '1 parked' testdata/golden/roadmap-parked-100x30-mono.txt` finds the heading.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In a 100x30 terminal, open the Overview with a stopped engine run selected: the detail under the rows shows two lines, the second `N of M steps  AGE`. Resize to 80x24: still two lines, nothing cut.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In a 100x30 terminal, park an item on the Roadmap with `P`: the heading changes to `... open, 1 parked` without `other` when no other status is present.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In a colour terminal at 100x30, open the run pane of a run in its second implementer round: the times, vendor, `#1` and token count line up readably; then start ork with `LC_ALL=C` (ASCII, `internal/brand/mark.go:60-68`) and the gate verdict uses `x`.
